events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place in Bethel, New York, starting on August 15, 1969.

angles.name: Remembering Woodstock
angles.copy: 57 years ago today, the legendary Woodstock Festival kicked off. Three days of peace, love, and music that defined a generation. What was your favourite performance?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: August 16th marks the anniversary of the death of the 'King of Rock and Roll', Elvis Presley, in 1977.

angles.name: The King's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977. His music and charisma continue to inspire generations.

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: September 7, 1996, marks the date legendary rapper Tupac Shakur was shot in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas; he died six days later on September 13.

angles.name: Tupac's Enduring Impact
angles.copy: On September 7th, we remember Tupac Shakur, a voice that shaped a genre and continues to resonate. His influence on hip-hop culture is undeniable.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: On September 18, 1970, the world lost one of its most influential guitarists, Jimi Hendrix.

angles.name: Jimi's Guitar Genius
angles.copy: Today we remember the legendary Jimi Hendrix, whose revolutionary guitar playing changed music forever. What's your favourite Hendrix track?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic album 'Abbey Road' was released on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 57 years ago today, The Beatles released 'Abbey Road'. That legendary album cover and timeless tracks still sound incredible.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and rock'n'roll attitude are truly iconic.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock'n'roll swagger. What's your favourite Oasis track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' single anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic song 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK on October 24, 1975.

angles.name: The Power of Imagine
angles.copy: On this day in 1975, John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK. Its message of peace and unity resonates as strongly as ever.

events.title: Apple iPod anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled its first iPod, revolutionising portable music, on October 23, 2001.

angles.name: The original iPod turns 25
angles.copy: Remember this? The original Apple iPod was unveiled 25 years ago today, changing how we listen to music forever. What was on your first iPod?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of 'Dr. No' in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred, of course) to 007 and his incredible legacy. What's your favourite Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles' co-founder John Lennon.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the life and enduring legacy of John Lennon. A true visionary.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedy is truly timeless.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Turns 58
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles released their iconic 'White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece that still sparks debate and adoration. What are your favourite tracks?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: November 24th marks the anniversary of the death of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie's Immortal Voice
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, who left us on this day in 1991. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Turns 61
angles.copy: Today marks 61 years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that saw them evolve their sound and songwriting. Still sounds fresh!
